tweet.text:
💡 Give Cursor / Claude Code "long-term memory" using just 50MB of RAM!

Excited to feature Mnemosyne — an incredible open-source project! @abdiisan 
Paired with Atlas Cloud's remote Embedding API, your AI Agent memory becomes both lightning-fast and lightweight:

❌ Say goodbye to local Docker / PostgreSQL / Qdrant resource hogging

✅ Pure SQLite architecture + Atlas Cloud API for fast vectorization

- 100% local context storage for complete privacy

- MCP protocol supported for one-click integration with top AI Coding Agents

pip install mnemosyne-memory

 Full Setup Guide: https://github.com/mnemosyne-oss/mnemosyne
